description: Said the hour aloud and did not write it.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Took the hour, repeated the empty chamber, and refused a second twenty shillings.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Not in the room. Named again as forbidden the lord's book.
name: Gib

description: Named first light, left the pages and the chronicle, and did not count.
name: William Shakespeare
